name: Phendimetrazine
summary: Phendimetrazine, sold under the brand name Bontril among others, is a stimulant medication of the morpholine chemical class used as an appetite suppressant.

pharmacology.text: Phendimetrazine can essentially be thought of as an extended-release formulation of phenmetrazine with less potential for abuse. Phendimetrazine is an anorectic drug which acts as a norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (NDRA).

uses.text: Phendimetrazine, sold under the brand name Bontril among others, is a stimulant medication of the morpholine chemical class used as an appetite suppressant.

sideEffects.en: Drugs of its class, the stimulants, can cause a fast heart rate, raised blood pressure, overheating, anxiety, sleeplessness and, with repeated use, dependence. It can also raise blood pressure and cause palpitations and dry mouth.
sideEffects.zh: 它所屬的興奮劑類藥物，可能引起心跳加快、血壓上升、體溫過高、焦慮、失眠，反覆使用還可能導致成癮。它也可能使血壓上升，並造成心悸與口乾。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它所属的兴奋剂类药物，可能引起心跳加快、血压上升、体温过高、焦虑、失眠，反复使用还可能导致成瘾。它也可能使血压上升，并造成心悸与口干。

fact.en: It is a prodrug of phenmetrazine, so the body has to convert it before it works, which spreads out its effect.
fact.zh: 它是苯甲嗎林的前驅藥物，必須先經人體轉換才會發揮作用，因此效果較為平緩分散。
fact.zhHans: 它是苯甲吗林的前驱药物，必须先经人体转换才会发挥作用，因此效果较为平缓分散。
